human_sources.role: Quotient lifts, their quasi-associativity and simultaneous coefficient comparison are developed in [Masuda], Sections 3–4. Here actual inner implementing unitaries and the left-section convention give the scalar formula (2.5). The pentagon, gauge identities and reconstruction are written out with that convention. Section 5 treats a common coboundary; the general common-associator comparison is [the following lesson](joint-quotient-comparisons-with-a-common-associator.md), Theorem 1.1.
